rules.submitted_commands: Exact JSON structure; ordered arrays, duplicate elements, omitted properties, null and empty strings remain distinct. Object property order is immaterial.
rules.article_tag_state: Membership uses unique strings; do not trim or case-fold. Preserve raw arrays and separate sorted-unique response representation checks.
rules.article_tag_create: Omitted tags predict []; null tags are unsupported invalid input, not defaulted.
rules.article_tag_update: Omitted tags preserve prior membership; [] clears tags. Do not infer null behavior.
rules.profile_update: For bio/image only, omitted preserves prior value; explicit null or empty string predicts null output. Identity changes and credential changes remain outside this helper.
rules.native_form: Settings filters null values on submission. New article tags are trimmed by the native addTag control; this is observed native behavior, not permission for the harness to trim registered input.
rules.article_partial_null: Unresolved and outside accepted-state helper; never replace explicit null with baseline through null-coalescing.
rules.other_applications: No new coercions for PetClinic or Quartz. Retain existing exact registered representations until a separate source-qualified rule is registered.

authority: Pinned implementation expectation; not an independent normative requirement or defect label.
